_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. install.ps1 creates config.json from this file on first run.

llm._upgradeDelaySec: others must stay vram.upgradeMarginMiB under a bigger tier's limit this long before it loads
llm._downgradeLoadDelaySec: outside games: after a downgrade unloads the bigger model, wait this long before loading the smaller one
llm._activityMaxTier: best tier allowed while a game/stream runs; applied the moment it starts, so the game launches with the memory free (games size texture pools at launch). "" = no cap
llm._activityPollSec: VRAM check interval while a game/stream runs (5 s otherwise)
llm._noLoadsDuringActivity: while a game/stream runs, only unload: model loads, upgrades and crash restarts wait until it ends (loading mid-game caused GPU driver resets)
llm._tiers: Best first. A tier is used while other programs (games, stream encoder, training jobs) use less GPU memory than maxOthersMiB. whisper=false also stops speech-to-text.

tailscale._comment: Remote access over your tailnet (see README > Tailscale). Set enabled=false for LAN-only.

serve._comment: HTTPS ports published inside the tailnet only (0 = don't publish).

cluster._comment: Multi-PC (README > Multiple PCs). role: "" = single PC, "orchestrator" = keeps the public ports and routes to itself or workers, "worker" = loads models only while the orchestrator asks.
cluster._workers: mac (optional): the orchestrator wakes the worker with Wake-on-LAN while it needs it and the worker hasn't checked in for 20 s
